_source: FROZEN copy of data/seed/compendium/raw/gearplanner_affix_synonyms.json (upstream site/src/assets/affix-synonyms.json). The gate diffs the vendored live table against this frozen one; any added/removed/re-pointed fold fails the build until a human confirms the two names are the same game mechanic. Re-freeze only in the same commit that handles the change.
_why: Upstream folds distinct mechanics under one affix name. Speed <- Striding is why #154 existed: Striding grants movement only, the Speed enchantment also grants melee/ranged attack speed, and the fold lost the attack-speed half silently.
_local_why: REPO-REVIEWED synonym folds that upstream gear-planner does NOT carry. The U6 gate (check_affix_synonyms) diffs ONLY the upstream 'affix_synonyms' section against the vendored live table, so entries here never trip the added/dropped/re-pointed fold events; registry_synonym_folds() merges this section on top for the pipeline channels that APPLY folds. Each entry cites its wiki evidence; a local synonym may not collide with an upstream fold key.
_local_staleness: #374 — vocabulary.check_local_synonym_staleness (called from build_dataset.assert_local_affix_synonyms) fails the build when a declared synonym matches nothing in the corpus: the raw gear-planner affix names + the augment-set seed stats (exact match) and the Dino wiki tier text (substring). This section previously had no assert_all_reached equivalent, so a fold could rot into a silent no-op — which is exactly what upstream's consolidation of the helpless family does to most of these spellings. An entry may allowlist a knowingly-absent spelling under unmatched_synonyms, with evidence; that allowlist is two-directional.

local_affix_synonyms.name: Damage to helpless enemies
local_affix_synonyms.evidence: docs/wiki-evidence/helpless-damage.md (#305): the ddowiki Helpless hub page lists every gear source of the ONE percent-extra-damage-vs-helpless mechanic in a single table; the canonical spelling is the one carried natively by the Solar Gem of Cruelty affixes.
local_affix_synonyms.unmatched_evidence: #374/U4 — the gear-planner refresh (upstream 767a7f7, 2026-08-18) CONSOLIDATED the whole helpless family to one spelling: only `Damage vs. the Helpless` (structured affix names) and `damage vs. the helpless` (Dino free text) still occur, so nine of the eleven #305 spellings now match nothing. Retained rather than deleted, on the precedent of the `Damage vs. Helpless` entry below it: every spelling here is a RECORDED WIKI WORDING (docs/wiki-evidence/helpless-damage.md tabulates each one with the set or item that carries it), upstream re-scrapes ddowiki near-daily, and a re-harvest or an upstream revert would bring the spelling back verbatim — at which point the fold must already exist or the one mechanic re-splits into two buckets silently. check_local_synonym_staleness is two-directional, so a returning spelling fails the build until its allowlist entry is dropped in the same commit. Per-spelling detail: `Damage vs. Helpless` is the Cruel Cut augment-set tier wording, canonicalized IN PLACE in data/seed/compendium/augment_sets.json by #305 (see its stat_note), so it was already a no-op before this refresh.

local_affix_synonyms.name: Well Rounded
local_affix_synonyms.evidence: #374/U4 — upstream RETIRED its own `all Ability Scores` -> `Well Rounded` fold in the 2026-08-18 refresh. The refresh-diff adjudication cleared that removal on structured-affix occurrence counts (the key occurs 0/0/0 in gearplanner_items/crafting/sets), but registry_synonym_folds also folds the DINO channel's verbatim wiki TIER TEXT, where the spelling is live: src/dino_native.py records `+3 Artifact bonus to all Ability Scores` (Echoes of the Walking Ancestors) and `+2 Profane bonus to all Ability Scores` (The Legendary Dread Isle's Curse). Without the fold those two sets stamp `via: "Artifact all Ability Scores"` while membership_set_defs — the live defs the SAME set is scored through, built from the structured sets catalog — stamps `via: "Artifact Well Rounded"`, so one mechanic on one set displays under two provenance labels. `Well Rounded` is DDO's enchantment name and the spelling every other channel emits (items stamp `Enhancement/Exceptional/Profane Well Rounded`), which is why it is the canonical here. Both spellings already expand to the same six abilities at the same bonus type, so no value, bucket or solve moves — this is display provenance only. Re-adopted locally rather than left to upstream, on the KTD1 principle: we keep the enchantment name a player reads on a tooltip.

local_affix_synonyms.name: Maximum Spell Points (%)
local_affix_synonyms.reason: #695 - ddowiki Named_item_sets states the Eminence of Autumn 4-piece as '+10% Legendary bonus to Maximum Spellpoints'. It is a PERCENT bonus to the maximum spell-point pool, and this repo already carries that stat under the canonical `Maximum Spell Points (%)`: ddowiki Lunar_and_Solar_Gems gives 'Arcane Endurance | Legendary Bonus to Maximum Spell Points | +3% +6% +10%', stored as {"name": "Maximum Spell Points (%)", "type": "Legendary", "value": "10"} on Solar Gem of Arcane Endurance (Legendary) - the same bonus type, magnitude and percent as this tier. #639 split the pool by unit and this lands on the percent side: flat maximum SP is `Wizardry` (Power Drain merged there), percent is `Maximum Spell Points (%)` (Mind Drain merged there). Folded HERE and not in affix_name_corrections.json because the sets channel round-trips through synthesized text: catalog_from_raw rebuilds the tier text from the renamed affix and set_parser re-parses it, converting a '(%)' canonical into a '%' value marker and materialising the DIFFERENT name `Maximum Spell Points` + unit=pct. The parse seam sets `stat` directly and leaves the tier `raw` verbatim.
